answer: A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 10 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a fable bet on surviving 44 epochs of grading, and every signal settlement recomputes the zenith schedule, so someone who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 44 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 24 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
